interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive diagnostics; no protocol, threshold, cache, or method selection is changed.
All declared heldout cache2/cache0 episodes are included in protocol order, including failures; unsealed, missing, and error episodes have unknown statistics, never zero-filled outcomes.
Repeated retrieval and episode failure may co-occur; these observations do not establish causality.
Cosine similarity measures the projected feature key, not action quality or task success.
A hit run is consecutive decisions retrieving the same index within one episode and cache; any miss or different index ends it. Decision counts are not independent trials or time durations.
Same task means identical suite and task_id in the frozen protocol; development and heldout initial states differ. A cross-task hit does not by itself establish transfer or generalization.
NFE counts action-head evaluations and is neither end-to-end latency nor quality-adjusted speedup. These diagnostics do not support effectiveness claims, including when the study is complete.
csv_layout: One row per planned heldout cache episode; null means unobserved or undefined. unique_cache_indices is a JSON array. Every decision is retained in JSON episodes[].decisions.
